mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy remains accommodative.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals weak labor market conditions that suppress consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales above 12-month moving average combined with low federal funds rate below 0.5% signals strong consumer demand and accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with low rates
failure_condition: The joint signal (RSAFS > 12mo_MA and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion (unemployment rate below 5.0%), declining industrial production below 90.0 signals supply constraints, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 and UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 600.0 thousand units indicate robust residential demand and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 600.0.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals potential monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Job growth above 12-month moving average combined with strong retail sales above 12-month moving average signals a strengthening labor market and consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS > 12mo_MA and RSAFS > 12mo_MA) fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 0.5% during a monetary tightening cycle signals reduced liquidity, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5%.
